correctness.rationale: When every polygon edge receives a sample, exact hull geometry replaces two nearest vertex rays by their chord. Thus the perimeter deficit is ∑G_theta(U_i,V_i). The joint absence probability of disjoint arcs of length O(1/N) yields 2m independent Exp(rate 1/P) limits. Dominated endpoint-gap tails and exponentially rare empty edges give all fixed moments. Writing U+V~Gamma(2,1), U/(U+V)~Uniform independently gives the displayed one-corner Laplace factor. Small-loss coefficients are 2/[P(1-cos theta)] per corner, and convolution gives 2^m/[m!P^m∏(1-cos theta_i)]. The first positive moment-generating singularity is at 1/[P(1-cos(theta_max/2))], so dividing the known Laplace factor recursively recovers all exterior angles. Rectangles with same perimeter but differing aspect ratio demonstrate nonidentifiability of lengths. Independent checking against the earlier weighted-corner small-tail theorem verifies the coefficient and normalization.
